newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar expects 1.0 mln viewers by Nov 97.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar expects 1.0 mln viewers by Nov 97.

text.p: EchoStar Communications Corp hopes to increase its number of subscribers to one million by November 1997 even though it currently has a little more than 100,000, the company's president said Tuesday.
"We're the fastest growing (direct satellite service)," Charlie Egen told Reuters.
EchoStar, the third largest U.S. operator, has been aggressively selling its home dishes at competitively low prices.
Egen, whose company entered the business in March, said he expected to send up two satellites with the next two years on future space launches.
In early September, EchoStar sent its second satellite, EchoStar II, up with the Ariane space launch in French Guiana.
The Lockheed Martin Corp Series 7000 satellite had 16 transponders capable of transmitting in excess of 100 additional channels for DISH Network.
EchoStar offers subscribers scores of music and television channels through direct satellite transmission to the home.
